props.title: Commands and tools
props.lead: Agents work on pages through MCP tools. Scripts, server startup, diagnostics, and administration use the CLI. Both call the same services and access the same content library.

content.text: The CLI is a Node.js script that exits each time it executes a command and does not require a resident service or open window. below
Represents the actual command prefix and is not installed globally.

# 独立运行包（需要 Node.js 22.12+）
node /绝对路径/runtime/scripts/cli.mjs projects list --json

# macOS 桌面 App 自带的运行时（无需另装 Node）
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "/Applications/ShowAI.app/Contents/MacOS/ShowAI" \
  "/Applications/ShowAI.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/scripts/cli.mjs" projects list --json
The local executable file, CLI path and environment variables will be given, just copy them directly.
Use the specified content library; you can also use environment variables
Specify the project. When omitted, it will be parsed according to the Git root directory where the current directory is located.
Use this directory instead of the current directory to resolve the project
Display the overview without a command; return the guide corresponding to the command with a command
And exit with non-zero code, page conflict (
Search for commands, descriptions, or parameters, or filter by group. Expand a command to see parameters and examples.

commands.summary: Start the local browser workbench
commands.detail: Only listens on 127.0.0.1; defaults to using a free port and opening the browser. Read and write the same content library as the desktop app.

commands.summary: Start stdio MCP in content library mode
commands.detail: No project binding: Tool calls must explicitly pass the projectId; projects_list, project_resolve, and project_create can be used to select projects. The ShowAI plugin uses this mode by default.

flags.meaning: page_present writes the location of the preview file

commands.summary: Start stdio MCP in project mode
commands.detail: The connection is pinned to an existing project; passing in other projectIds will be rejected.

flags.meaning: Preselect a task template for this connection (can only be used with --project)
page_present writes the location of the preview file

commands.example: claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope local showai-P -- node /abs/cli.mjs mcp --project P

commands.summary: Launch an MCP with only public resources
commands.detail: Does not read any project data, only provides the public directory, guide and render_document. Does not accept --project or --templates.

commands.summary: Start HTTP MCP service
commands.detail: For remote clients to connect via HTTPS, the protocol is showai-agent-http-v1. Task templates are selected by the client with template_context, --templates is not accepted.

flags.meaning: Service status directory, by default located in local/agent-server of the content library
Sync servers to allow access to private projects, comma separated

commands.summary: View runtime version and capabilities
commands.detail: Returns the version, capability protocol, capacity, and reader compilation method (readerCompilation). Used by the plugin launcher to check runtime compatibility.

commands.summary: Register the current runtime into the content library
commands.detail: Writes the content library's agent-runtime.json, which the plugin uses to find the CLI. The desktop app will automatically register when it starts; the independent running package needs to be executed manually once.

commands.summary: Parse the items corresponding to the current directory
commands.detail: Determine the project in the order of --project → --source-directory → the Git root directory where the current directory is located, and create it if it does not exist. Multiple sessions in the same directory share a project.

flags.meaning: The absolute path of the host project
Explicitly specify projects with the highest priority

commands.summary: List items in the content library
Create a new independently named project
commands.detail: For normal work, use projects current to parse by directory; create a new project only if you need a separate project.

flags.meaning: Records the Agent session that created it (metadata)

commands.summary: Binding of record projects to Agent sessions
commands.detail: Bindings are only saved as metadata and do not determine the default write location.

commands.summary: Read the how-to guide for a topic
commands.detail: Without a topic, all topics are listed. The topics are shown in the table below;`guide presentation --stage STAGE `reads a stage in which the system presents a baseline.

commands.summary: List pages in project
commands.detail: Returns title, ID and current hash.

commands.summary: Create new page
commands.detail: Page is created by default; it can be created from page JSON and the component package in the file will be imported into the project.

commands.summary: Read the page as structured data
commands.detail: By default, JSON, hash, and revision are returned. The read retains a baseline for later diffing.

flags.meaning: Markdown makes it easy to read text and component data
outline only lists structure and stable IDs
Read only the selected area (partial projection, cannot be used to save the entire page)
Only the original source code is returned and the derived value of the component is not calculated in the browser.

commands.example: showai pages read PAGE --project P --detail outline --json

commands.summary: Render the page to PNG
commands.detail: Render saved pages in an isolated browser. Requires Chrome, Edge or Chromium on this machine, or SHOWAI_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE set.

flags.meaning: Reject screenshots when the page has changed

commands.example: showai pages read PAGE --project P --view image --theme dark --width 1000 --out shot.png --json

commands.summary: Generate interactive HTML and inspect the DOM
commands.detail: Returns the accessibility tree and post-interaction state. --state files can contain a viewport, a theme, and a list of actions (hover, click, fill, select, check, uncheck, drag).

flags.meaning: Enable component editing only in preview, without writing back to the page

commands.example: showai pages read PAGE --project P --view html --state reading-state.json --out preview.html --json

commands.summary: Apply a set of edits by block ID
commands.detail: Operations include page.set, block.insert/remove/replace/move, block.text.set, block.attrs.set, component.insert, surface.create/wrap/layout.set, etc.

Indicates this modification and inclusion in the editing group; reuse the operation-id when retrying the same request.

commands.example: showai pages apply PAGE --project P --input ops.json --base-hash H --base-revision R --json

commands.summary: Replace current content with complete page
commands.detail: Must be based on the latest complete read; partial projections cannot be used for saving.

flags.meaning: The content hash obtained when reading; if the content has changed, CONFLICT is returned

Indicates this modification and inclusion in the editing group; reuse the operation-id when retrying the same request.

commands.summary: List changes since last read
commands.detail: Returns new additions, deletions, moves, and field changes by block ID, including user modifications in the workbench. Returns MISSING_BASELINE if no baseline is found.

commands.summary: Read Board as image
commands.detail: Small artboards return a complete image; large artboards return an overview and overlapping tiles, as well as element indexes. Subsequent queries use the returned snapshotId to fix the same interception.

flags.meaning: Specify the Board to be read when the root is Page

commands.summary: Export single file HTML
commands.detail: By default, the reader, content and component running code are packaged and can be opened directly offline.

flags.meaning: remote requires a verified publishing address and requires an Internet connection when reading.

commands.summary: Export the HTML snippet displayed within the session
commands.detail: For use by Agent hosts that support HTML display. Components must be bundled; final compressed fragment cannot exceed 1,000,000 bytes, or selected chunks are exported with full HTML attached.

commands.summary: Export the entire project as a static website
commands.detail: Archived pages will not be exported. The website uses shared reader resources and needs to be accessed via HTTP or deployed to static hosting.

commands.summary: Export only selected blocks or containers
commands.detail: ID is the attrs.id of the page node (use pages read --detail outline to view). The selected container contains the entire subtree; partial export uses reading layout by default and hides page titles.
commands.example: showai export --project P --page PAGE --blocks CHART_ID,METRICS_ID --format html --out ./selected.html --json

commands.summary: Directly render a page JSON without going through the project
commands.detail: Standalone presentation: not saved to any personal project. For formal work, the page should be saved first and then exported.

commands.summary: Render a standalone page using a public template
List public components and templates
commands.detail: No login or project required.

commands.summary: Read the description of a public component or template
List available components or templates
commands.detail: By default, all built-in components plus components of the current project are returned, including name, description, scene and identity used to query details. Does not include schema and source code.

commands.summary: Read a view of a component or template
commands.detail: Views: summary (default), guide, development, parameters, schema, examples, dependencies, source, full. full does not contain source code and running code.

flags.meaning: Pinpoint different versions of the same name
Read the specified file in the source view; '*' is a complete package
Save to file, return only path

commands.example: showai catalog describe chart --view schema --project P --json

commands.summary: Read parameter descriptions by field paging
commands.detail: Put together the schema, field meanings, and real examples.

commands.detail: The input is JSON (manifest, schema, source code files and resources) exported by the source view. After modification, save it with a new version number.

commands.detail: Copy the complete dependency closure without uploading anything. You must explicitly write --to global; the project-bound MCP cannot perform this step.

commands.detail: The input contains three precise references: base, ours, and theirs. By default only the conflict summary is returned.

commands.summary: Save merged results in new version
commands.detail: The input needs to include the reviewed resolved package and new version; record parents and mergeBase.

commands.detail: Stages: intent, evidence, understanding, design, authoring, review. Returns the system guide plus the guide for the selected template at the same stage.

flags.meaning: Inherit the result of template context
Read a subfile in the guide folder

commands.example: showai template guide design --project P --templates my-template --json

commands.summary: Create pages from templates, or insert existing pages
commands.detail: When used alone, new resources are created and the container type of the template is maintained; when --page is added, the template root node is inserted as a module, and all IDs are remapped together with the view reference.
